{{Top|leg}}
A '''Multi-channel Comm Unit''' was an inbuilt system included in [[GTU]]'s [[AV-1 power armor|AV-1]] series of [[Power armor/Legends|power armor]]. It had a 50 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] range, an external amplifier, and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] encoder.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
